name: iFLYTEK
summary:
iFLYTEK develops speech, language, vision and cognitive AI technology, with applications spanning education, healthcare, industry and intelligent devices. Its Spark model family provides a foundation for understanding and generating language, while its speech and multimodal systems support interaction between people and machines.

In robotics, its Robot Super Brain platform connects multimodal interaction with model-based understanding and decision-making. This places iFLYTEK primarily in the intelligence and interaction layer of the humanoid ecosystem. Its technology is intended to help robots interpret requests, respond naturally and connect conversational capabilities with the requirements of physical tasks.
